description: Configuration for prediction tracking, Brier score calculation, and calibration drift detection

brier_score_thresholds.description: Thresholds for interpreting Brier score calibration quality

rationale.marginal: Approaching random chance for binary predictions
rationale.poor: Worse than random guessing; indicates systematic miscalibration

minimum_validations.description: Minimum sample sizes for statistical significance
minimum_validations.rationale: Fewer observations produce unreliable calibration metrics

rationale.window_size: Analyze last N predictions for trend detection
rationale.direction_threshold: Flag if >60% of errors are in same direction

lr_adjustment_rules.description: Rules for recommending LR table updates based on observed outcomes

rationale.divergence_for_flag: 20% divergence between expected and observed warrants attention
rationale.minimum_sample: Need at least 5 observations for empirical LR estimate
rationale.max_change: Limit single update to 2x change to prevent overcorrection

staleness_thresholds.description: When predictions become stale if not validated

rationale.stale: Mark as stale after 2 years (unlikely to ever validate)
rationale.archive: Archive after 3 years (no longer affects metrics)

outcome_types.description: Valid outcome types for recording validations

confidence_buckets.description: Buckets for calibration analysis by confidence level

prediction_log_settings.description: Settings for the prediction log file

usage_notes: All thresholds should be accessed via config_loader.py
Actual outcome: 1 for ARCHITECT confirmed, 0 for PRAGMATIST confirmed
Predictions use probability of ARCHITECT classification
Changes to this file require cache clear via config_loader.clear_config_cache()
